result.instructions: Tools for SimplyRETS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find active 3-bedroom homes in Houston under $500,000, newest first."; "Which open houses are scheduled this weekend?"; "Give me market statistics for listings in zip code 77096.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SimplyRETS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run simplyrets_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run simplyrets_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run simplyrets_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. simplyrets_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: simplyrets_get_account_info
tools.title: Get account info
tools.description: What these API credentials can reach: the MLS vendor ids (needed as `vendor` on multi-MLS apps), the time of each vendor's last sync, usernames and the available endpoints (/properties, /openhouses, /agents, /offices, /properties/analytics). OPTIONS /.

tools.name: simplyrets_get_feed_metadata
tools.title: Get feed metadata
tools.description: Values present in an MLS feed, to build valid searches: statuses, property types, cities, counties, neighborhoods, areas and features, plus the last sync time. OPTIONS /properties.

vendor.description: MLS vendor id; required on multi-MLS apps (simplyrets_get_account_info lists them).

tools.name: simplyrets_search_listings
tools.title: Search listings
tools.description: Search MLS listings (SimplyRETS /properties): by keyword, status, type, price, beds, baths, area, year, city, zip, neighborhood, agent, broker, features or a map polygon. Returns address, price, status, photos, agent, office, property details and remarks, without empty fields. Pass count=true to get the total. Page with next.offset or next.lastId. GET /properties.

q.description: Keyword search over MLS number, street, unit, city, postal code, subdivision and area; several values match any.

status.description: Listing status (default Active). Closed = sold or leased.

subtype.description: Property sub type; not every feed supports every value.

agent.description: Listing agent MLS ids (the co-listing agent is not matched).

brokers.description: Broker or listing office ids, as your MLS provides them.

maxdom.description: Maximum days on market (needs Days on Market data in the feed).

cities.description: Cities (case-insensitive). simplyrets_get_feed_metadata lists the cities in the feed.

pool.description: Pool: 'true', 'false' or a value such as 'Private'.

points.description: A polygon of 'lat,lng' points (3 or more); returns listings inside it. Needs latitude/longitude in the feed.

idx.description: IDX display filter. Default 'null' hides listings whose address or entire listing may not be displayed online; 'ignore' returns them too. Your MLS's display rules still bind how you use the data.

vendor.description: MLS vendor id; required on multi-MLS apps (simplyrets_get_account_info lists them).

subTypeText.description: Original MLS sub type text values.

specialListingConditions.description: Special conditions such as REO, Short Sale or Auction (feed dependent).

minlistdate.description: Listed on or after this date or date-time (UTC unless a timezone is given).

maxlistdate.description: Listed on or before this date or date-time (UTC unless a timezone is given).

modified.description: Only listings whose MLS modification time is on or after this date or date-time.

include.description: Extra fields: compliance (IDX display data) and rooms (when the feed has them).

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus is descending. Ignored with lastId.

count.description: Also return the total number of matches (slower on big feeds).

offset.description: Records to skip (the previous reply's next.offset). Do not combine with lastId.

lastId.description: Cursor: 0 for the first page, then the previous reply's next.lastId (sort is ignored when set).

tools.name: simplyrets_get_listing
tools.title: Get listing
tools.description: One listing by its SimplyRETS id (`mlsId`, the number in search results; NOT the public MLS number `listingId`). Full detail: address, geo, price, photos, agent, office, property, school, tax, remarks. GET /properties/{mlsId}.

mlsId.description: SimplyRETS listing id (the `mlsId` field of a search result).

include.description: Extra fields to include, when the feed has them.

vendor.description: MLS vendor id; required on multi-MLS apps (simplyrets_get_account_info lists them).

tools.name: simplyrets_list_open_houses
tools.title: List open houses
tools.description: Upcoming open houses with the listing they belong to: filter by property type, listing id, city, broker, agent, price, size, beds, baths and start date. Page with next.offset or next.lastId. GET /openhouses.

type.description: Property type of the listing (default residential; one type per query).

listingId.description: Only open houses for this public MLS listing id.

startdate.description: Scheduled start of the open house.

sort.description: Sort field; a leading minus is descending. Ignored with lastId.

vendor.description: MLS vendor id; required on multi-MLS apps (simplyrets_get_account_info lists them).

offset.description: Records to skip (the previous reply's next.offset). Do not combine with lastId.

lastId.description: Cursor: 0 for the first page, then the previous reply's next.lastId (sort is ignored when set).

tools.name: simplyrets_get_open_house
tools.title: Get open house
tools.description: One open house by its key (the `openHouseKey` of a list result). GET /openhouses/{openHouseKey}.

vendor.description: MLS vendor id; required on multi-MLS apps (simplyrets_get_account_info lists them).

tools.name: simplyrets_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: The agent roster of the MLS feed: id, name, address, contact and office. Needs the Agents API add-on on your SimplyRETS app (the demo credentials return an empty list). GET /agents.

q.description: Search agent ids and email addresses.

name.description: First name, last name or both.

vendor.description: MLS vendor id; required on multi-MLS apps (simplyrets_get_account_info lists them).

offset.description: Records to skip (the previous reply's next.offset). Do not combine with lastId.

tools.name: simplyrets_list_offices
tools.title: List offices
tools.description: The brokerage office roster of the MLS feed, newest modification first. Needs the Offices API add-on on your SimplyRETS app (the demo credentials cannot use it). Pass count=true for the total. GET /offices.

q.description: Match office MLS id, main office MLS id, email (exact) or name (partial).

username.description: Feed username, when the credentials have several for the vendor.

count.description: Also return the total number of matches.

vendor.description: MLS vendor id; required on multi-MLS apps (simplyrets_get_account_info lists them).

offset.description: Records to skip (the previous reply's next.offset). Do not combine with lastId.

tools.name: simplyrets_get_market_analytics
tools.title: Get market analytics
tools.description: Statistics for the listings a search matches (same filters as simplyrets_search_listings): total count, average price, bedrooms, full baths, living area, lot size and year built, and the number of listings per area. Use it for market summaries of a city, zip or price band. GET /properties/analytics.

status.description: Listing status (default Active). Closed = sold or leased.

subtype.description: Property sub type; not every feed supports every value.

agent.description: Listing agent MLS ids (the co-listing agent is not matched).

brokers.description: Broker or listing office ids, as your MLS provides them.

maxdom.description: Maximum days on market (needs Days on Market data in the feed).

cities.description: Cities (case-insensitive). simplyrets_get_feed_metadata lists the cities in the feed.

idx.description: IDX display filter. Default 'null' hides listings whose address or entire listing may not be displayed online; 'ignore' returns them too. Your MLS's display rules still bind how you use the data.

vendor.description: MLS vendor id; required on multi-MLS apps (simplyrets_get_account_info lists them).

tools.name: simplyrets_get_listing_analytics
tools.title: Get listing analytics
tools.description: Analytics for one listing, such as its price per square foot. GET /properties/{mlsId}/analytics.

mlsId.description: SimplyRETS listing id (the `mlsId` field of a search result).
